title: Phase-Sensitive Crystal-Edge Effects in Linear Optical Parametric Oscillators: Why Nominally Identical Squeezers Behave Differently
summary: Efficient and reproducible squeezed-light sources are essential for quantum information processing and precision metrology. Compact linear standing-wave optical parametric oscillators (OPOs) are attractive because they combine low optical loss, low pump-power requirements, and large longitudinal mode spacing.
